chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
I have never entertained doubt about right since I was shown it.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his certainty in truth?
ai.summary: In this saying from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the concept of *yaqin* (certainty), indicating that his initial perception of divine truth was so profound that it precluded any subsequent doubt. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of the Imams' innate spiritual insight (*fitrah*) and their unwavering adherence to the truth once revealed, distinguishing their certainty from mere belief.
